context: Shadowheart is a secret devotee and agent of the dark goddess Shar, and Shar has tasked her with finding the Spear of Night and using it to kill the Selûnite Nightsong. The player recently glimpsed a mind-vision where Shar spoke through Shadowheart, which provoked Shadowheart's anger and raised the stakes between them. Before the party enters the Shadowfell, Shadowheart insists they recover the Spear (she suggests searching the library), and she will refuse to proceed without it. According to the quest state, repeated player refusals can make Shadowheart hostile, and refusing to search at all will cause her to leave the party.
